title: Video Editor
emptyHeroDesc: Trim and arrange clips, add background audio, overlays, blur sensitive areas, and export high-quality video directly in your browser.
dropHint: Drop a video file here, or click "Add clip".
gifTooLong: A GIF longer than {{seconds}} seconds gets very large. It will still export, but MP4/WebM is usually the better choice.
errNoFrames: No frames could be read from the selected range.
exportDone: Export done — the file has downloaded.
errMissingSource: Could not find this clip's original file.
errInvalidExport: Can't export with the current settings.
errExportEmpty: Export failed — no output was produced.
errNoVideoTrack: This file has no video track.
errNoVideoCodec: Your browser can't encode video for this format.
errImportFailed: Could not read this video file.
errImportAudioFailed: Could not read this audio file.
errNoAudioTrack: This file has no audio track.
blurHint: Draw a box over anything that should not be readable — it stays put for the whole clip.
multipleAudioTracks: This file has {{count}} audio tracks. Pick which one to extract.
exportLocked: Editing is locked until the export finishes.
errNoCanvas: Could not create the render canvas.
modeRippleHint: Ripple: removing or moving a clip closes the gap. Click to switch to Overwrite.
modeOverwriteHint: Overwrite: gaps are kept where you leave them. Click to switch back to Ripple.
multiSelected: {{count}} clips selected — changes apply to all of them.
overlayHint: A solid box hides completely — safer than blur for a password or a token. Text is for captions.
binEmpty: Nothing imported yet. Add video, audio or images — they stay here until you remove them.
placeOnTimeline: Click to place at the playhead, or drag onto a track
errUnsupportedFile: That file type is not supported.
frameSizeHint: Pick the shape of the finished video first — scale, position and captions are all measured against it. You can change it later.
timelineEmpty: Drag a file from the media panel onto the timeline.
boxHint: Drag the box on the preview, or type exact values here.
extractAudioHint: Moves this clip's sound onto its own audio track, where it can be trimmed and faded separately.
moveTrackUp: Move track up (draws over the ones below)
